codeCoverageInstrumentationSpec.description: The {@link CodeCoverageInstrumentationSpec} applied to the package.

excludedFilePaths.description:
The list of file paths that are excluded from code coverage. As of 8.7 Platform, this is only applied to
`js-server` or `js-rhino` files that match a path regex in {@link CodeCoverageInstrumentationSpec#excludePaths}.

title: Type to store code coverage results for a package.
